name: Esyasoft Freshers Survival & Training Knowledge Base

daily_schedule.title: Daily Schedule & Timing Routine
daily_schedule.summary: Structured daily cadence followed by Batch 2026 engineers to excel in training and maintain compliance.
points: 07:15 AM — Wake-up followed by a 20-minute morning stretch or gym session at the campus wellness center.
08:15 AM — Cafeteria breakfast (Adya Foods poori, upma, boiled egg, coconut chutney) and morning coffee refill.
08:50 AM — Arrive at the training facility and complete Biometric Punch-IN before the strict 09:00 AM cutoff.
09:00 AM to 01:00 PM — Morning Domain Deep-Dive Lecture sessions on Smart Grids, AMI, and HES architectures.
01:00 PM to 02:00 PM — Lunch break in the cafeteria and a relaxing stroll around the campus greens.
02:00 PM to 05:30 PM — Afternoon hands-on lab, coding sandbox, and MDM / VEE pipeline exercises.
05:30 PM to 06:45 PM — Evening cutting chai, snacks, and recreation (Foosball, Billiards, Table Tennis, Gym).
06:45 PM — Biometric Punch-OUT on scanner terminal before heading out (salary secured for the day!).
08:00 PM — Dinner, cohort banter, weekend coastal getaway planning, and restful sleep.
Pro Tip: Set a recurring daily smartphone alarm at 08:52 AM labeled 'RUN TO BIOMETRICS' to avoid cutoff panic.

attendance_and_leave.title: Attendance, Biometrics & Leave Policies
attendance_and_leave.summary: Mandatory HR attendance rules, biometric scanner requirements, and Zoho People regularization procedures.
points: Prabhu's Immortal Golden Rule: 'If you forgot to check in check out you won't get salary!' Compliance is mandatory.
Biometric Punch IN: Must be completed at the terminal scanner before 09:00 AM sharp every weekday morning.
Biometric Punch OUT: Completed upon finishing training at 06:30 PM / 06:45 PM to complete your daily record.
Zoho People Integration: Terminal biometric punches automatically synchronize with your Zoho People attendance card.
Attendance Regularisation: If you forget to punch IN or OUT, you must submit a regularisation request via Zoho People (Attendance > Apply Regularisation) with a valid reason before 11:00 AM.
100% Attendance Expectation: The 3-month foundation training program moves rapidly; full physical attendance is expected.
Emergency & Medical Leaves: Apply formally under Zoho People > Leave Tracker and notify Manager Prabhu / Training Coordinator via email or Microsoft Teams in advance.
Assessment Sprints: Casual leaves are strictly restricted during ongoing evaluation modules and require prior leadership sign-off.

campus_life.title: Campus Life, Recreation & Accommodation
campus_life.summary: Recreation facilities, sports arenas, cafeteria tips, and room living essentials for Batch 2026.
points: Foosball & Gaming Arena (Level 2): 2-vs-2 battles and billiards tables open 05:00 PM – 08:00 PM.
Foosball Etiquette: Absolutely NO 360-degree rod spinning (Prabhu can hear rattling rods down the hall!), keep goal celebrations modest, and clear balls swiftly.
Campus Gym & Fitness Arena (Level 1): Cardio treadmills, dumbbells, and cable towers open morning and evening. Mural motto: 'Only Bad Workout Is The One You Don't Do.'
Campus Library & Study Lounge: Backlit geometric bookshelves and ergonomic reading pods with smart-grid literature. Hours: 08:00 AM – 10:30 PM (keep phones on silent/vibrate).
Cafeteria & Food Services (Adya Foods): Daily breakfast (poori, upma, boiled eggs, chutney), wholesome lunch thalis, and steaming 05:30 PM cutting chai.
Accommodation Living Suites: Air-conditioned living lounge with flat-screen smart TV, sofa couches, and spacious dorms.
Room Essentials Checklist: Multi-plug spike guard with surge protector, GoodKnight mosquito repellent, 1L insulated water bottle, and quick-dry microfiber bath towels.

benefits_and_support.title: Stipend, Benefits & IT Helpdesk Support
benefits_and_support.summary: Monthly stipend guidelines, IT hardware provisioning, corporate credentials, and employee support channels.
points: Monthly Stipend / Salary: Processed on time based on verified biometric punch records synced from Zoho People; maintaining zero punch flags protects your full payout.
Enterprise IT Provisioning: Every fresher is issued a high-performance corporate laptop, secure VPN credentials, MFA authentication, and high-speed Wi-Fi access.
Corporate Communications: Microsoft Outlook (@esyasoft.com) for formal calendar lectures and Discom briefs; Microsoft Teams for live labs, chat, and mentor screen-shares.

IT Helpdesk & Sandbox Support: Never install unauthorized third-party VPNs. Raise support tickets on the internal Esyasoft IT Portal or post in the MS Teams IT Support channel with your employee ID and asset tag.
Mentor & Coordinator Support: Training coordinators and senior domain architects are accessible daily on MS Teams and in the training facility to unblock technical or personal issues.

training_programme.title: Training Programme, Smart Grid Curriculum & Core Values
training_programme.summary: The 90-day graduate roadmap, smart metering technical architecture, and Esyasoft's guiding corporate pillars.
points: Programme Structure: 3-month (90-day) intensive engineering onboarding; Batch 2026 has successfully survived the first 15-day crucible (16.7% Grid Ready).
Phase 1 Induction (Days 1–2): Executive leadership welcome, biometric enrollment, Zoho People setup, Outlook & Teams provisioning.
Smart Grid & AMI Architecture (Days 3–6): Smart meters, two-way communication gateways (RF Mesh, Cellular NB-IoT/4G), and Head-End Systems (HES).
Meter Data Management & VEE (Days 7–10): MDM data ingestion engines, VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing) rules, interval load profiles, and billing determinants.
Grid Edge Analytics & Loss Reduction (Days 11–15): Transformer load monitoring, tamper/theft detection, and Aggregate Technical & Commercial (AT&C) loss reduction for 40+ global Discoms.
Esyasoft Scale: Global smart grid leader with 50M+ connected smart endpoints across 10+ countries.
Our Guiding Creed: 'Explore, Grow, Prosper' supported by the 3 Core Pillars: 1) Delivery Excellence, 2) People First, 3) Technology Excellence.
Fresher Motto: 'Just Go With The Flow' — stay curious, embrace teamwork, and thrive through every technical sprint.
